findings.message: "RAKITAN LACI ATAS" hits "frame depan tegak tgh atas" by up to 1 mm in 8 place(s) (peluncur side mounted full ext Soft Closing (SH - ABC), tempelan muka laci, panel muka laci atas).
"RAKITAN LACI ATAS" hits "frame peluncur laci" by up to 1 mm in 2 place(s) (peluncur side mounted full ext Soft Closing (SH - ABC)).
"RAKITAN LACI ATAS" hits "frame profil tegak dalam" by up to 1 mm in 8 place(s) (peluncur side mounted full ext Soft Closing (SH - ABC), tempelan muka laci, panel muka laci atas).

"RAKITAN LACI BAWAH" hits "frame depan datar bawah" by up to 12 mm in 10 place(s) (papan samp laci, frame support tengah laci, papan muka - blk laci, klos segitiga laci, klos 150 laci, papan dasar laci bawah).
"RAKITAN LACI BAWAH" hits "frame profil datar atas - bwh" by up to 15 mm in 3 place(s) (panel muka laci bawah, tempelan muka laci, papan muka - blk laci).
"RAKITAN LACI ATAS": box outside width 337 mm, but opening 360.5 − 2 × 12.7 slide clearance = 335.1 mm (too wide by 0.9 mm per side, tolerance ±0.5).
"RAKITAN LACI BAWAH": box outside width 712 mm, but opening 766 − 2 × 12.7 slide clearance = 740.6 mm (too narrow by 14.3 mm per side, tolerance ±0.5).

"frame depan datar bawah" is 794 mm on the BOM, but the space between the legs at that height is 876 mm. The model draws it leg to leg (41 mm longer at each end) so the front has no holes. Check the cutting length, or set the assumption "faceFrameCorners" to as-bom to see the gap.

"frame profil datar atas - bwh" is 794 mm on the BOM, but the space between the legs at that height is 876 mm. The model draws it leg to leg (41 mm longer at each end) so the front has no holes. Check the cutting length, or set the assumption "faceFrameCorners" to as-bom to see the gap.
Fronts + rails + reveals need 1262 mm but the opening (front profiles) is 1232 mm: 30 mm over across 5 rows.
"RAKITAN LACI ATAS": front 362 mm in 360.5 mm openings — inset with 2 mm reveal needs 356.5 mm (too wide by 5.5).
"RAKITAN LACI BAWAH": front 737 mm in 766 mm openings — inset with 2 mm reveal needs 762 mm (too narrow by 25).
Outer edges of the drawer rows are off by up to 15.3 mm (left 15.3, right 15.3).
7 hardware line(s) without a SKU: peluncur side mounted full ext Soft Closing (SH - ABC), mur nanas, adj glide, sekrup, counter weight (tekel), name plate, anti tipping.
dustPanel: BOM has 1, the layout needs 4 (4 level(s) between drawer rows (dust panels are optional)).
Runner "frame peluncur laci" is 391 mm in 388 mm between the front frame and the back.
Runner "frame peluncur tengah" is 391 mm in 388 mm between the front frame and the back.
Clothing storage 1473 mm tall (≥ 686 mm / 27 in). Target market is not set; if sold in the US it needs an anti-tip kit and a test (kit is on the BOM). Needs verification per market.
